sentences.en: His career prospects at the company are not too promising.
sentences.zh: 他在公司的职业前景并不乐观。

sentences.en: The prospect of famine hangs over many areas of the world.
sentences.zh: 饥荒的阴影笼罩着世界上许多地区。

sentences.en: Our prospects for victory are excellent at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们目前取得胜利的可能性非常大。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pro（向前）+spect（看）→向前看→前景
